hint.apAhrsInconsistent: The IMU cores disagree, usually stale calibration. Recalibrate the accelerometers. In SITL, restart with "Wipe EEPROM".
hint.apAhrsNotReady: The attitude estimate is not ready. Keep the vehicle still and give it a minute, or fix the sensor errors shown above.
hint.apAirspeed: The airspeed sensor is not responding. Check its wiring and the pitot tube.
hint.apBaro: The barometer is not responding. Check the flight controller hardware and reboot.
hint.apBattery: The battery is low or not reported correctly. Charge or replace it, and check the battery monitor if the reading looks wrong.
hint.apBoardType: The configured board type does not match this flight controller.
hint.apCompassInconsistent: The compass readings disagree or the magnetic field looks wrong. Move away from metal and power cables, check each compass orientation, then recalibrate.
hint.apCompassUncalibrated: The compass has not been calibrated, or its calibration no longer fits.
hint.apCompassUnhealthy: A compass is not responding. Check its wiring and that it is detected.
hint.apEkfAttitude: The EKF cannot converge. Keep the vehicle still. In SITL, restart with "Wipe EEPROM" and wait 60-90 s after boot.
hint.apFence: The fence needs a position, or the vehicle is outside it. Wait for a GPS lock, or move the vehicle inside the fence.
hint.apFrameClass: The frame layout is not set for this vehicle. Set the frame class and type to match how the motors are arranged.
hint.apGeneric: No automatic fix is known for this check. The message comes straight from the flight controller; the pre-arm reference explains each one.
hint.apGpsNotReady: The GPS has no usable fix yet, or is not detected. Wait under open sky; if it persists, check the GPS setup.
hint.apGyro: The gyros disagree or are not calibrated. Keep the vehicle completely still and reboot, or run a gyro calibration.
hint.apLogging: Logging is not available: the SD card is missing, full or failed. Insert or replace the card.
hint.apMission: The mission cannot start as it is. Check it in the mission planner.
hint.apNeed3dFix: Waiting for a GPS 3D fix. Move to open sky and wait.
hint.apNeedAlt: The EKF needs an altitude estimate. This follows from other sensor errors, fix those first.
hint.apNeedPosition: The EKF needs a valid position. Wait for a GPS lock and 60-90 s after boot for it to converge.
hint.apRadioFailsafe: The flight controller is in radio failsafe. Switch the transmitter on and check it is bound, and that its throttle range sits above the failsafe value.
hint.apRangefinder: The rangefinder is not responding. Check its wiring. If none is fitted, its type must be set to none.
hint.apRcUncalibrated: The radio channels have not been calibrated.
hint.apSafetySwitch: Press and hold the safety switch on the vehicle until its light goes solid.
hint.apThrottleHigh: Throttle is not at minimum. Pull the throttle stick fully down, and check its trim on the transmitter.
hint.apWaitOrReboot: The flight controller asks you to wait for the sensors to settle, or to reboot it.
hint.px4Accel: The accelerometer is not calibrated or inconsistent.
hint.px4Attitude: The attitude estimate is not stable. Level the vehicle, reduce vibration and let the estimator settle.
hint.px4Battery: The battery is low or unhealthy. Charge or replace it, and check the battery setup if the reading looks wrong.
hint.px4Esc: An ESC or motor problem was detected. Check the ESC wiring, telemetry and motor outputs.
hint.px4Generic: No automatic fix is known for this check. The message comes straight from the flight controller; the preflight check reference explains each one.
hint.px4Geofence: A geofence condition is blocking arming. Move the vehicle inside the fence, or review the fence.
hint.px4GpsFix: Waiting for a GPS fix. Move to open sky and wait; if it persists, check the GPS setup.
hint.px4Gyro: The gyroscope is not calibrated. Keep the vehicle completely still during calibration.
hint.px4Home: The home position is not set yet. Wait for a valid position so home can be captured.
hint.px4KillSwitch: The kill switch is engaged. Disengage it on the transmitter before arming.
hint.px4Mag: The magnetometer is not calibrated, or its readings disagree. Move away from metal and power cables and recalibrate.
hint.px4PositionEstimate: The position estimate is not ready. Wait for a GPS lock under open sky and for the estimator to settle.
hint.px4Radio: The radio is not calibrated or its signal is lost. Switch the transmitter on, check it is bound, and calibrate it.
hint.px4Vibration: High vibration or accelerometer clipping. Improve the flight controller mounting and isolation, and balance the props.

calibrationLost.consequence: It was written but did not survive the restart. The aircraft is flying on whatever was there before.
calibrationLost.title: The last {{type}} calibration is not on the aircraft

compassWeak.consequence: Position hold may wander or circle. Recalibrating away from metal and power wiring usually fixes it.
compassWeak.title: The compass calibration is weaker than it should be

ekfFailsafeReportOnly.consequence: The navigation failsafe is set to report only. If position or heading goes bad in flight, the aircraft will keep trying to fly the mode you are in.
ekfFailsafeReportOnly.consequenceWeakCompass: Your compass calibration is already weak, and the navigation failsafe is set to report only. A confused aircraft will keep flying instead of landing.
ekfFailsafeReportOnly.title: If the aircraft loses track of where it is, nothing will happen

ekfThresholdDisabled.consequence: Nothing will stop you arming with a bad heading or position estimate, and the in-flight failsafe cannot trigger either.
ekfThresholdDisabled.title: The navigation quality check is switched off

fenceRtlWithWeakCompass.consequence: Flying home needs the same heading your compass calibration is weak on. Landing where it is does not.
fenceRtlWithWeakCompass.title: On a fence breach the aircraft will try to fly home

px4BatteryWarningOnly.consequence: The aircraft will keep flying on an empty pack until it falls out of the sky. Nothing lands it for you.
px4BatteryWarningOnly.recommend: Return when critical, land when empty
px4BatteryWarningOnly.title: A flat battery will only produce a warning

px4FenceNoAction.consequence: The fence is set to take no action, so it will not hold, return or land the aircraft when it leaves the allowed area.
px4FenceNoAction.title: Crossing the geofence does nothing

px4FenceRtlWithWeakCompass.consequence: Flying home needs the same heading your compass calibration is weak on. Holding where it is does not.
px4FenceRtlWithWeakCompass.recommend: Hold position instead of flying home
px4FenceRtlWithWeakCompass.title: On a fence breach the aircraft will try to fly home

px4GcsLossDisabled.consequence: If telemetry drops while the aircraft is out of RC range, it will carry on with no way to reach it.
px4GcsLossDisabled.title: Losing the ground station link does nothing

px4MagCheckDisabled.consequence: Nothing will stop you arming next to steel or with a magnetometer reading nonsense.
px4MagCheckDisabled.recommend: Refuse to arm on a bad compass
px4MagCheckDisabled.title: The compass strength check is switched off

px4RcLossTerminates.consequence: Flight termination and disarm both drop the aircraft where it is. A brief RC dropout becomes a crash.
px4RcLossTerminates.title: Losing the radio will cut the motors
